    1. defer(Supplier, Supplier)

Schnittstelle Deferrable2<A1,A2,B>

Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first input
A2 - the type of the second input
B - the result type of the computation
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Fun2<X1,X2,Y>, Komparator<A>, Operator2<A>, Pred2<A1,A2>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Deferrable2<A1,A2,B>

Functional interface describing a computation with two inputs that can be deferred. Instead of passing the inputs directly, they are provided as Suppliers so that evaluation can be performed on demand.

This is useful when computing inputs is expensive or when execution order and timing should be controlled explicitly.

  • Methodendetails

    • defer

      @NonNull Callable<B> defer(@NonNull Supplier<A1> a1, @NonNull Supplier<A2> a2)

      Returns an executable handle that, when called, obtains the two inputs from the given suppliers and performs the computation to produce the result.

      Contract: the suppliers must not be null and must not supply null values. The returned handle must not return null.

      Parameter:
      a1 - a Supplier providing the first input; must not be null
      a2 - a Supplier providing the second input; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Callable performing the deferred computation
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any supplier is null or supplies null
